build_mmrB2_benchmark_from_hf: build the MMRB2 benchmark locally by downloading all subsets from HuggingFace and converting to JSON format
build_single_subset_from_hf: build a single subset like t2i or edit from HuggingFace using the --subset flag
extract_images_and_text: extract images and text from HuggingFace format with image placeholders into benchmark content pairs
convert_hf_row_to_benchmark: convert a single HuggingFace dataset row into benchmark format with prompt and response content
get_available_configs: get the list of available dataset configs from a HuggingFace repository ID
